Data 360 Inspector

All-in-one toolkit for Salesforce Data Cloud — explore data, export segment rules & transforms, query any object to CSV. Read-only, zero setup.

● Read-only · nothing leaves your browser
🔍 Data 360 Inspector ↖ Drag me to your bookmarks bar
❓How to install & use
1. Show your bookmarks bar — ⌘⇧B (Mac) / Ctrl⇧B (Windows).
2. Drag the Data 360 Inspector button above onto the bookmarks bar. No install, no permissions.
3. On any Data Cloud / Data 360 page, click the bookmark — a purple circle button appears bottom-right; click it for the menu.
4. Click the bookmark again anytime to remove the tool. It never overlaps the Salesforce nav.

What it does

Works on these pages (the launcher shows only that page’s buttons) — click a row to see what you can do. All read-only.

DLO → DMO Mapping CanvasData StreamDLODMOData Model (ERD)Data ExplorerSegmentQuery EditorData Transform
🔁DLO → DMO Mapping CanvasAPI TooltipPin API namesExport
Hover any DLO→DMO field to see & copy its API name, or pin all names on the canvas at once. Export the full mapping table (filter by DMO) to Sheets or CSV.
🌐Data Stream & DLOExport Fields
Export every field — API name, label, data type, status, key qualifier — to Sheets or CSV.
🗂DMO DetailExport Fields
Fields tab (API name, type, mapped status, key qualifier) plus Relationships tab (related objects, join fields). Copy for Sheets or Download XLS.
🗺️Data Model (ERD)Diagram
On the Data Model graph page, generates a copyable Mermaid ERD of your entities & relationships (paste into Lucidchart, draw.io, or GitHub) with a cardinality legend and searchable entity cards showing each object’s connections.
🏁SegmentExport Rules
Reads all conditions (Include / Exclude / Rank & Limit) from the builder — full AND/OR logic, nested segments, sub-filters. Copy to Sheets or download as HTML / Excel.
📊Data ExplorerColumnsExport CSV
See all columns (past SF’s 10-column view; the object’s own view loads 100 rows). Pick / reorder / save columns, sort, multi-filter, live count, inline Edit SQL. Export All to CSV up to 500K rows (paginated, cancelable).
🔎Query EditorRun & Export
Run any SQL and export the full result as CSV up to 500K rows (paginated, progress + cancel) — beyond the 1,000 rows the Query Editor grid shows on screen.
⚙️Data TransformView Definition
Auto-reads the definition into a plain-English, branch-by-branch summary: sources, filters, formulas, joins, outputs, fields kept / dropped / renamed. Download as HTML (printable to PDF). Optional AI explanation.

Modals are draggable & resizable. Click Remove in the menu to take the tool off the page.

🔒Privacy & safety
  • Runs entirely in your browser — no external servers, no third-party services.
  • Uses Salesforce’s own APIs (same-origin). No data leaves your browser or your org.
  • Nothing is stored permanently — the tool disappears on page reload. Column selections use localStorage (per-org, 90-day TTL).
  • Read-only: it never creates, modifies, or deletes any Salesforce data.
  • No installation required — no package, no Connected App, no admin approval.
